messages:
clare: dropped a compact inline helper variant for first-run that pins under the header. figma: https://figma.com/file/compact-helper-2026 — quick eyes please :eyes:
anya: quick a11y pass: collapsed state needs a visible focus target and an accessible name. current CTA label contrast is 3.1:1 (fail).
dom: impl note: client-only flag is quick, but cross-device dismissal needs server flag. also if we auto-create keys/projects we should be explicit in the microcopy.
miko: copy nit — keep CTAs verb-first. options: 'Create sample', 'Start quickstart', 'Browse samples'. prefer shortest. include hint: 'Includes API key + run command'.
sam: telemetry names to standardize: `onb.helper_impression`, `onb.helper_click`, `onb.sample_create`. add cohort id and experiment_id on impressions.
anya: accessibility fixes: bump button bg to #1f3a93 to meet contrast, add 3px focus outline, increase body text to 16px, aria-live="polite" for creation status. ensure focus returns to helper on close.
a11y-bot: scan results: compact helper fails collapsed keyboard focus; expanded panel needs role="dialog" and focus-trap. secondary text contrast ratio 3.2:1 (borderline).
clare: UX question — should the helper auto-create a sample on click or open a modal with explicit 'Create' step? miko: prefer explicit creation to avoid surprise resources. make CTA say 'Create sample' and confirm in a small modal.
dom: rollout plan: client flag + a11y fixes = 1 sprint; server dismiss + telemetry hooks = +1 sprint; modal confirm flow = optional +1 sprint.
clare: next steps: 1) anya to update comps with contrast + focus states; 2) miko to lock CTA copy and microcopy; 3) dom to prototype client flag and draft server flag; 4) sam to add telemetry names to ONB experiment ticket. I'll file ticket and attach figma.
sam: can we run two 5-min smoke tests with new signups for first-call success?
anya: I'll attach a small a11y checklist: keyboard nav, SR announce on create, focus return, contrast checks.
clare: filed ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-1105 — please add comments. thanks! :sparkles:
